'''TK-9H4''' was a [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtrooper]] for the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], and presumably one of [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Nial Declann]]'s personal bodyguards.

==Biography==
In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]], TK-9H4 was stationed in the [[Theed Royal Palace/Legends|Theed Royal Palace]], alongside Declann and another stormtrooper, designated [[TK-8H2]].

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
TK-9H4 is a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|Non-Player Character]] (NPC) in the [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|MMORPG]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]''. In the game, the stormtrooper simply guards Nial Declann.
